# Psalm 23 — Disagreement Log
**Generated by:** SOPHIA | **Threshold:** <70% word overlap

---

## 23:3 (overlap: 0%)

- **EMET:** My-soul He-restores; He-guides-me in-paths of-righteousness for-His-name's-sake.
- **LOGOS:** He restores my soul. He leads me in paths of righteousness for His name's sake.
- **PNEUMA:** He renews my strength. He guides me along right paths, bringing honor to His name.

**SOPHIA ruling:** LOGOS reading adopted for consensus. EMET preserves source-language structure; PNEUMA captures interpretive meaning. All three contribute valid perspectives.

## 23:5 (overlap: 5%)

- **EMET:** You-prepare before-me a-table in-the-presence of-my-enemies; You-anoint with-oil my-head; my-cup overflows.

- **PNEUMA:** You prepare a feast for me in the presence of my enemies. You honor me by anointing my head with oil. My cup overflows with blessings.

**SOPHIA ruling:** LOGOS reading adopted for consensus. EMET preserves source-language structure; PNEUMA captures interpretive meaning. All three contribute valid perspectives.
